lab_catalogue.test: CBC: hemoglobin/hematocrit, platelets, differential
lab_catalogue.when: Suspected bleeding, anemia, infection context or thrombocytopenia
lab_catalogue.question: Blood-loss trend, oxygen-carrying capacity and platelet trend
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform bleeding/transfusion evaluation or drug-exposure review alongside clinical findings
lab_catalogue.limit: Hemoglobin can lag acute hemorrhage or reflect dilution; WBC does not prove infection; platelets do not measure all platelet function

lab_catalogue.test: Arterial blood gas when oxygenation, ventilation or acid-base status needs clarification
lab_catalogue.when: New respiratory failure, altered support or unexplained acid-base disturbance
lab_catalogue.question: PaO2, PaCO2 and pH under recorded oxygen/support conditions
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform respiratory-support assessment and whether a metabolic/respiratory process is changing
lab_catalogue.limit: Venous PO2 cannot replace arterial oxygenation assessment; record FiO2/device; do not schedule ABGs automatically

lab_catalogue.test: Lactate, with repeat justified by a response question
lab_catalogue.when: Shock or unexplained change in perfusion
lab_catalogue.question: Trend compatible with altered production/clearance or delivery-demand imbalance
lab_catalogue.decision: May prompt reassessment of shock mechanism or response to an intervention
lab_catalogue.limit: Not specific for hypoperfusion and not a standalone fluid, transfusion or inotrope trigger

lab_catalogue.test: Basic metabolic chemistry: sodium, potassium, bicarbonate/total CO2, urea/BUN, creatinine and glucose
lab_catalogue.when: AKI, oliguria, arrhythmia, diuresis, metabolic or neurologic concern
lab_catalogue.question: Electrolyte/acid-base changes and kidney-function trajectory
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform medication-exposure review, electrolyte management or renal-support evaluation
lab_catalogue.limit: Creatinine lags injury; an isolated value does not distinguish low flow from congestion or choose dialysis

lab_catalogue.test: Magnesium and phosphate when clinically relevant
lab_catalogue.when: Arrhythmia, nutritional risk, ongoing losses or respiratory-muscle concern
lab_catalogue.question: Potential reversible electrolyte contribution
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform replacement assessment and review of losses or drug effects
lab_catalogue.limit: Not every abnormal value explains the illness; replacement needs kidney function and local policy

lab_catalogue.test: Ionized calcium
lab_catalogue.when: Major bleeding/transfusion or unexplained circulatory dysfunction
lab_catalogue.question: Biologically active calcium in the current clinical context
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform correction assessment while investigating the primary problem
lab_catalogue.limit: Total calcium is not interchangeable; sampling/pH and clinical context matter

lab_catalogue.test: PT/INR, aPTT and fibrinogen selected for the question
lab_catalogue.when: Bleeding, hepatic/coagulation concern or relevant anticoagulant exposure
lab_catalogue.question: Selected clotting-pathway/fibrinogen abnormalities
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform hemostatic or anticoagulant assessment with bleeding history and drug identity
lab_catalogue.limit: Do not equate a normal screen with no bleeding risk or use INR to quantify every anticoagulant

lab_catalogue.test: Viscoelastic/platelet-function testing if indicated and locally available
lab_catalogue.when: Active complex cardiac-surgical bleeding under an established clinical pathway
lab_catalogue.question: More specific clot formation or platelet-function questions
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform component-directed hemostatic discussion and distinguish hypotheses
lab_catalogue.limit: Does not replace surgical source evaluation; not a routine screening or independent treatment algorithm here

lab_catalogue.test: Type and screen / compatibility testing through the transfusion service
lab_catalogue.when: Clinically meaningful bleeding or a realistic transfusion question
lab_catalogue.question: Compatibility and preparation for potential blood-product support
lab_catalogue.decision: May support timely transfusion logistics if the clinical team determines need
lab_catalogue.limit: Not a transfusion indication, hemoglobin target or proof of ongoing bleeding

lab_catalogue.test: Source-directed microbiology, including blood cultures when indicated
lab_catalogue.when: Suspected infection, new fever with a plausible source or shock
lab_catalogue.question: Organism identification and susceptibility/context
lab_catalogue.decision: May refine antimicrobial/source-control decisions and later de-escalation
lab_catalogue.limit: Avoid reflex cultures from every site; contamination/colonization matter; sampling must not cause harmful treatment delay

lab_catalogue.test: Respiratory sample / pathogen testing selected for suspected pneumonia
lab_catalogue.when: New pulmonary infection question
lab_catalogue.question: Potential respiratory pathogen evidence
lab_catalogue.decision: May refine antimicrobial assessment with imaging and clinical course
lab_catalogue.limit: Positive results may reflect colonization; specimen quality, prior therapy and immune status matter

lab_catalogue.test: Urinalysis, microscopy and selective culture
lab_catalogue.when: Kidney-injury mechanism or suspected urinary infection
lab_catalogue.question: Sediment/urine findings and source-specific microbiology
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform AKI differential or urinary-source evaluation
lab_catalogue.limit: Pyuria or bacteriuria is not automatically symptomatic infection; catheter and collection method matter

lab_catalogue.test: Serum sodium with osmolality/urine studies if the specific question warrants them
lab_catalogue.when: Neurocritical electrolyte/water-balance problem
lab_catalogue.question: Patterns of water/solute regulation in context
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform supervised fluid/medication reassessment and correction planning
lab_catalogue.limit: No universal sodium target or rapid-correction instruction follows from this vignette

lab_catalogue.test: Prompt bedside glucose when mental status or metabolic stability changes
lab_catalogue.when: Reduced consciousness, agitation or unstable metabolic state
lab_catalogue.question: A potentially reversible glucose abnormality
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform immediate clinical assessment and supervised correction
lab_catalogue.limit: An abnormal result does not exclude a concurrent neurologic or circulatory event

lab_catalogue.test: Troponin when a myocardial-injury question is present
lab_catalogue.when: New ischemic/rhythm/pump concern after assessment
lab_catalogue.question: Myocardial injury pattern with serial context if justified
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform coronary/structural evaluation together with ECG and imaging
lab_catalogue.limit: Postoperative elevation alone does not establish type, mechanism or an infarction diagnosis

lab_catalogue.test: Hemolysis evaluation: LDH, plasma-free hemoglobin, bilirubin/haptoglobin as appropriate
lab_catalogue.when: ECMO/LVAD blood-trauma concern, anemia or device alarm
lab_catalogue.question: Evidence compatible with hemolysis, integrated with device data
lab_catalogue.decision: May prompt specialist evaluation of pump/circuit/loading or alternative causes
lab_catalogue.limit: Each marker is nonspecific; no single result proves pump thrombosis or selects a speed/anticoagulant change

lab_catalogue.test: Anticoagulant-appropriate assay, e.g. anti-Xa or aPTT under the actual protocol
lab_catalogue.when: Mechanical support, bleeding/thrombotic concern or anticoagulant monitoring need
lab_catalogue.question: Exposure/effect question specific to the medicine, assay and timing
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform specialist anticoagulant assessment
lab_catalogue.limit: Assays are not interchangeable; interferences and concurrent drugs matter; no universal target supplied

lab_catalogue.test: Selected hepatic chemistry/bilirubin
lab_catalogue.when: Congestion, shock, hepatobiliary or medication-exposure concern
lab_catalogue.question: Hepatic injury/cholestasis pattern or congestion context
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform perfusion/differential assessment and drug handling review
lab_catalogue.limit: Abnormal tests do not uniquely distinguish ischemia, congestion, obstruction or drug injury

lab_catalogue.test: Lipase when pancreatitis diagnosis remains a live question
lab_catalogue.when: Compatible abdominal presentation or uncertain diagnosis
lab_catalogue.question: Evidence contributing to diagnostic criteria with history/imaging
lab_catalogue.decision: May help establish the disease context and need for further evaluation
lab_catalogue.limit: Serial lipase is not a target for resuscitation or a substitute for organ-failure assessment

lab_catalogue.test: Agent-specific drug level when indicated by the treating transplant/pharmacy protocol
lab_catalogue.when: Potential immunosuppressant toxicity, interaction or exposure problem
lab_catalogue.question: Concentration at the correct timing for the actual agent
lab_catalogue.decision: May inform specialist exposure/interaction assessment alongside organ function
lab_catalogue.limit: Not every agent uses the same level/target; an isolated value does not diagnose rejection

nonlaboratory_catalogue.test: Focused cardiac imaging, TTE and specialist TEE when appropriate
nonlaboratory_catalogue.question: Ventricular function/loading, pericardial or valvular/mechanical questions
nonlaboratory_catalogue.decision: May redirect shock assessment toward pump, obstructive or structural causes
nonlaboratory_catalogue.limit: A limited study can miss pathology; postoperative windows and loculated collections complicate interpretation

nonlaboratory_catalogue.question: Rhythm, conduction and ischemic-pattern questions
nonlaboratory_catalogue.decision: May inform rate-related or ischemic evaluation with perfusion assessment
nonlaboratory_catalogue.limit: Rate alone does not establish causation or choose a drug/pacing setting

nonlaboratory_catalogue.test: Chest imaging / lung ultrasound when indicated
nonlaboratory_catalogue.question: Tube/line or pleural/parenchymal explanation for deterioration
nonlaboratory_catalogue.decision: May distinguish mechanical or pulmonary hypotheses and guide further evaluation
nonlaboratory_catalogue.limit: Not a routine daily-image instruction; findings alone may not separate edema from infection

nonlaboratory_catalogue.test: Neuroimaging and neurologic reassessment when indicated
nonlaboratory_catalogue.question: New structural explanation for reduced consciousness or focal change
nonlaboratory_catalogue.limit: Do not attribute new decline to sedation without evaluating competing urgent causes

nonlaboratory_catalogue.question: Aortic, graft, limb or organ malperfusion question
nonlaboratory_catalogue.decision: May prompt surgical/vascular or device-team reassessment
nonlaboratory_catalogue.limit: Transport/contrast risks must be balanced against the urgency; a normal lab does not exclude malperfusion

nonlaboratory_catalogue.test: Abdominal imaging or pressure assessment chosen for the suspected problem
nonlaboratory_catalogue.question: Source control, obstruction, pancreatitis complication or intra-abdominal hypertension
nonlaboratory_catalogue.limit: Pressure alone does not establish compartment syndrome; a test is not a dressing-change order

nonlaboratory_catalogue.test: Specialist device/circuit review with appropriate imaging, gases and trends
nonlaboratory_catalogue.question: LVAD/ECMO performance, loading, cannula or oxygenator questions
nonlaboratory_catalogue.decision: May identify a mechanism requiring expert adjustment
nonlaboratory_catalogue.limit: Displayed flow, one gradient or one post-membrane gas is not a complete diagnostic rule

domains.response_stability: Reassess comfort, unwanted effects, communication and family concerns; DNR is not synonymous with this separately specified plan.
